content: TRAVEL_BUFFER_MINUTES = 45: Every booked job reserves its own start/end time plus an additional 45-minute travel buffer for the technician. Source: pipeline/decisions/feature-1-decisions.md, TechnicianAvailabilityService.java. Any downstream feature that reasons about how many jobs fit in a technician's day must use this constant, not a guess.

LIVE BUG — Feature 1 overlap detection: bookJob() rejects a new booking only if its start time exactly matches an existing booking's start time. It does not check whether the two time ranges genuinely overlap. Two jobs with different-but-overlapping start times for the same technician are both silently accepted. Any consumer that assumes 'a technician's booked slots never overlap' is relying on a guarantee the current code does not provide. Source: pipeline/decisions/feature-1-decisions.md.

Net available stock formula (feature-2): net_available = physical_quantity − SUM(active_reservation_quantities). This is the authoritative formula for all inventory calculations in Feature 2. Source: requirements.md AC-1.

OPEN BUSINESS QUESTION — partial-stock policy (feature-2): The repository does not define whether a shortage allows partial reservations or whether the whole reservation must fail. No default policy is assumed. This absence blocks task T-02. Source: requirements.md AC-3, design-review.md.

BA agent invented all-or-nothing partial-stock policy without repository evidence; corrected by human intervention (3 interventions on this point alone). Pattern: BA agents on policy-sensitive features tend to invent policy. Mitigation: require BA agents to cite repository evidence before asserting any business policy. Source: memory-architecture.md §1.2 episodic events.

STANDING RULE (feature-2): ReservationCritic exceptions must return structured 422 responses, not 500s. The original design returned HTTP 500 on critic exceptions; design-review finding 2 required structured error handling. Source: design-review.md, memory-architecture.md §1.2.

Design review verdict: Needs Changes. Partial-stock policy is the open gate blocking task T-02. No build agent may implement T-02 until the partial-stock business question is resolved and recorded. Source: design-review.md, memory-architecture.md §1.2.
